integrity.numerical_reproducibility: CHECK.py runs 27979 finite standard-library checks; these corroborate but do not prove the all-dimensional theorem
integrity.proof_basis: exact Fourier block calculation, Haar-character argument, explicit angular integration and standard limit/moment theorems
integrity.provenance_claims: No authorship, independent audit or formal certification claimed

scientific_limitations: The exact independent-fiber law requires continuous uniform phases; it is not claimed for finite phase alphabets, Gaussian windows or multiple translations.
The order of the condition-ratio limit concerns squared frame bounds, not the raw synthesis matrix.
Independent publication priority and human verification have not been established.

scientific_scope.geometry: translations 0 and 1; even modulation residues; integer p at least 2
scientific_scope.normalization: unit norm window; every phase entry has modulus 1/sqrt(2p)
scientific_scope.quantities: frame-operator spectrum, sharp frame bounds, determinant and condition ratio
scientific_scope.window: independent continuous Haar unit phases on the cyclic group of even order 2p

title: Independent spectral fibers and a Weibull hard edge for phase-only cyclic Gabor bases
